OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The entity types the connector enriches.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

REPORT_ARTICLE_FETCHER_USER_AGENT.description: User-Agent sent when fetching article pages.

REPORT_ARTICLE_FETCHER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout of one page request, in seconds.

REPORT_ARTICLE_FETCHER_MIN_LENGTH.description: Shortest extracted article accepted, in characters of text.

REPORT_ARTICLE_FETCHER_LENGTH_RATIO.description: The article must be this many times longer than the report's current text.

REPORT_ARTICLE_FETCHER_MIN_TITLE_SIMILAR.description: Lowest match accepted between the report name and the page (0 to 1): page title, words of the name at the top of the text, or URL slug.

REPORT_ARTICLE_FETCHER_MATCH_SINGLE_REFE.description: Also accept reports not created by the RSS ingestion when they have exactly one external reference.
